There is no prose, no mathematics, no code and no figures, so all eight judgment rules - qe-writing-002, 003, 005, 007, qe-math-009, 014, 015 and qe-code-001 - have nothing to apply to. The entire rendered page is generated by sphinxcontrib-bibtex from the `.bib` file, so any style question about its content belongs to the bibliography entries, which live outside this repository's corpus
